sampling: Body prose paragraphs and bullet items (headings, tables, display math, code excluded), numbered from line 14; paragraph 2 and every third after it (2, 5, 8, ..., 92): 31 paragraphs; 15 claims drawn from them.

A: L46 and L78-82: the graph definition G=(N,E,phi) is given twice, the second time as display math in a different section with a contradictory gloss.
L305 '이 지연 수치에서 무엇이 측정되었는지는 구분해서 읽어야 합니다.' is an orphan paragraph; nothing follows it before the next heading (the network-latency caveat is back at L257).
L125 is a lone one-sentence paragraph ('"2주 전에 새 직장을 시작했어요"라는 말은 ...') between subsections.
Front matter, $$-only math, single header rows and heading levels are fine.
B: L29 '이 수치가 상대 하락인지 %p 하락인지, 기준값과 결과값은 이 근거에 제시되어 있지 않습니다.' is pipeline language leaking into the TL;DR (rewrite: drop the sentence; L326 gives 94.6% -> 80.4%).
L82 '$$\phi$$가 무엇을 나타내는지는 여기서 인용한 근거에 정의되어 있지 않습니다.' is the same evidence-ledger leak.
L146 'Graphiti는 Zep의 지식 그래프 엔진입니다.' is dropped mid-paragraph between two invalidation sentences (rewrite: move to first mention or fold in: 'Zep의 그래프 엔진인 Graphiti는 ...').
L364 '여기에 이 글의 관점에서 몇 가지를 덧붙입니다. ... 마지막으로' gives two points and a '마지막으로' with no first/second.
Otherwise consistent 입니다 register and natural engineer prose.
C: L263 '앞서 소개한 대로, 여러 세션으로 이루어진 다중 세션 대화로 구성됩니다' and L278 '앞서 본 세션 구성을 모두 합쳐도' point back to a DMR composition (500 conversations, 5 sessions, up to 12 messages) the post never states.
L251 says both experiments use the top 20 items, then L263 says DMR used the top 10; the post notes it but does not reconcile (the paper itself is inconsistent).
The Seoul->Busan example is retold at L38, L156-167, L235-247, L280, L299, L336; the DMR-section retelling (L280) does not connect to the DMR argument.
D: Good: bi-temporal walk-through table (L162-165), label-propagation neighbour count (L183-193), same-entity-pair dedup example (L113).
Over-padding: repeated re-explanations of edge invalidation in results sections (L299, L336) instead of pointing back.
E: DMR (L265-274), LongMemEval (L286-291) and question-type (L317-330) tables match the paper's cells.
L187-191 neighbour table restates the sentence before and after it (mildly redundant).
No visual for the three-tier graph / retrieval pipeline where one would help (the layer table L66-70 partly covers it).
F: L29 (TL;DR): claims the paper gives neither the baseline/result values nor whether the single-session-assistant drop is relative; the paper's Table 3 gives 94.6%->80.4% (gpt-4o) and 81.8%->75.0% (gpt-4o-mini) and the post's own table at L320/L326 shows them. Wrong (-2).
L82: says phi is not defined in the cited evidence; the paper defines it ('phi: E -> N x N represents a formal incidence function') and the post itself does at L48. Wrong (-2).
Hypothetical examples are labelled as such (L38, L185, L235); all table cells checked match.
